subject: REWRITE statement
notes: "The file position indicator in the rewrite file connector is not affected by the execution of a REWRITE statement." Sequential: OverwriteInPlace saves stream.Position, writes at the last-read anchor and seeks back, leaving the reader's position; relative: Put at _lastSlot/_pendingKey, no position change; indexed: position held as key+ordinal values, Rewrite does not touch them. Probe pa.cob: READ(rec 2) / successful REWRITE / READ delivers record 3 (CCCCCCCCCC); pd.cob: READ key 1 then READ NEXT delivers key 2 after two REWRITEs. cite.py --check 14.9.35.4 GR13 -> OK. No spec-derived test.
